# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- On the Approvals page, keep only the status and department dropdown filters; employees should be displayed as table rows, not an employee dropdown. The employee search box should be functional.
- Changes may be made to the page specifically requested by the user. Only modify the specifically requested page and avoid blind or unrelated code changes; inspect the existing implementation before applying targeted fixes.

## Configuration Guidelines
- For the Configuration page, prefer simple human-written WinForms code, default controls, no decorative theme styling, no inline comments, no tables or search for Approval/Clearance settings, and keep changes limited to the two Configuration files when possible.
